name: Olfen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, red and yellow with a broad red middle stripe, charged at the top with the city arms of Olfen (yellow figures on red).
history: Municipal flag of Olfen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Olfen arms — yellow figures on red
